description: The bonds a company sold, tranche by tranche, from the SEC filings that priced them: amount, coupon, maturity, price, yield, spread over Treasuries (mid-swaps for euro bonds, the index for floating notes), benchmark and CUSIP from each final term sheet, with the XBRL fee tables of final prospectuses confirming amounts and adding deals priced without one. Each dollar yield is recomputed from its price. Yearly totals by currency. Registered deals only.

company.description: Ticker, CIK or name. A financing arm files under its own name: pass Ford Motor Credit or Toyota Motor Credit, not the parent.

deals.description: The most recent term sheets to read, newest first; default 10.

years.description: How far back to look; default 5.

name: bond_offerings

outputSchema.description: offerings is a table of tranches, newest first: priced, security, kind, currency, amount, gross_proceeds, reopening, coupon_pct, coupon, maturity, tenor_years, price_pct, yield_pct, spread_bp, benchmark, benchmark_yield_pct, cusip, isin, from. deals groups the tranches priced on one day with their documents; by_year totals each year's borrowing by currency; checks lists every recomputed yield or spread that disagreed.

title: Bonds a company sold
